scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sentinelops/server" "npm run dev -w @sentinelops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinelops/server && npm run build -w @sentinelops/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @sentinelops/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sentinelops/server && npm run typecheck -w @sentinelops/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run dist -w @sentinelops/desktop
